notes: Splat Suite 1.15.2 - Caspar GPU bundle adjustment, probed from the installed COLMAP at run time (official Windows builds refuse it; a build compiled with it is accepted). Auto is the default on a measured full solve: 874 images, Ceres 20.0 min vs Caspar 8.6 min, identical registration, reprojection marginally better. The COLMAP build recipe ships under tools/colmap_build so the Suite owns its own COLMAP. Includes 1.15.1 (loop detection and rig constraints, both opt-in) and 1.15.0 (Handheld / Drone / Photos + detected 360 tick, Views 4 or 8).
